asr.full_text: hello and welcome to today's video it's about finance and the article is written by Maxwell Motama and the headline says VanEck plans to stake 70% of abacs in new avalanche ETF filing. VanEck updated its avalanche ETF filing to take up to 70% of a bucksX, with rewards reflected in the fund's net asset value. the main points here is 2. Dvanek may stake up to 70% of AVAX in its proposed Avalanche ETF 3. Coinbase crypto services will serve as the fund's initial staking provider 4. Staking rewards will be allocated to the fund after deducting a 4% fee, etc. The DINAV will be adjusted accordingly. The ETF will be custodial with Algorange Digital and Coinbase custody. Vaneque has taken a new step in crypto-backed ETFs by updating its proposed Avalanche fund, WavX, to include staking rewards. This move would allow the fund to generate income by staking up to 70% of its AOx holdings if approved by the scc pav x would be one of the first U.S. listed ETFs to combine spot crypto exposure with native tokens staking yield reflecting the evolving design digital asset investment products It's just the same here in its amending S1 filing with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission, Banach disclosed that DeWav may stake as much as 70 percent of its AVAX tokens. The goal is to generate staking rewards that would acclimate to the Fund-of-Warservice fee paid to its staking provider Coinbase Crypto Services. They always get paid first, of course. The rewards will be reflected in the ETFs net asset value, providing investors with potential yields, in addition to Aavex price exposure. This marks a shift in ETF design as it's incorporates the on-chain featuresof-of-Sake networks into traditional investment vehicles. Custody and index strategies emphasize security and transparency. Waneck will custody the future Funds Apex Holdings, with regulated providers including Anchorage Digital and Coinbase Custody. With regulated providers, I encourage digital & coinbase custody. Both custodians store crypto assets offline in cold wallets, offering secure handling of digital assets under regulatory oversight. The fund will not use leverage or derivatives, instead it will track the price of AVAX through the market vector, Avalanche benchmark rate, a custom index built from pricing data on major exchanges. This ensures a reliable price reference for the ETF while maintaining direct exposure to the token spot of value by avoiding derivatives the fund seeks to simply fire its structure and aligned with SSC expectations for physically backed crypto ETFs the inclusion of staking adds a yield component without introducing additional market risk pavx the trade a NASDAQ pending regulatory approval. If approved, Banex Avalanche ETF will trade under the ticker VaVX on the NASDAQ exchange. The product aims to offer investors a combination of capital appreciation and staking yield package in a familiar ETF format. BANAC is not alone in exploring this model. Bitwise has recently updated its own Spot Avalanche ETF filing to include staking. These filings signal a broader trend towards integrating blockchain native features into regulated investment products, the introduction of staking into ETF design could set the precedent for further funds tracking proof-of-stake assets if approved the VF funds may open the floor for similar offerings tied to networks like Solana, Polkadot and eth we're staking is a core part of token economics. oneX filing represents an effort to meet investor demand for both passive exposure and yield generation within the crypto asset class the sov responds to this proposal will likely shape of staking is integrated into future ETF projects in the US market That was the article If you liked the video then like it and subscribe for more videos In the end I will show you not my analysis about XRP but the ETF market here at the ETF tracker and here is a total number But the Marketer, the ETF tracker and look at this number, the DV yesterday was $58,9k and you can go by the 589 theory and all that. So make up your own mind about that and I will see you in the next one.
